description: clknetsim is provided by Chrony project. clknetsim tests clock-synchronisation programs over simulated networks and hardware-reference clocks. It redirects selected system calls to a simulation server and supports chrony, NTP, BusyBox and LinuxPTP clients. Geographic context: global. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. Source code and documentation are linked through the public repository; no software was installed or executed. The cited material was readable without payment. Reuse licence: GPL-2.0-or-later.  Only Linux is supported, and the emulated system calls implement a limited subset. The simulated CPU is effectively infinitely fast under the documented clock model. Potential simulation use: Investigate clock synchronisation in network scenarios. For catalogue navigation, platform-ns-3 offers related simulation context; this comparison does not assert an implemented connection.
